title: GOAL: unattended operation, first-night fixes (ship legacy goals, false post-merge red, orphaned reviews, fix-round root, V1-V4)
spec: Night of 2026-10-06/07, first night with PR 44 live. Ship adopted goals closed weeks before it was enabled and tried to roll back PRs 30/31/32 (revert PR 45 opened by the bug, closed by the Planner; ship disabled in pool.toml). Its post-merge gate is falsely red in .orchestrator/ship-wt. ai-apprentice stalled 8 h on orphaned spec reviews. luna-inbox T-0597 stayed held after its fix-round chain merged. Plus V1-V4 from the T-1667 verification (superseded T-1703/T-1704). Ship is re-enabled by the Planner only after this goal merges.
